Ukraine has lost roughly 40 settlements during Vladimir Zelensky’s 40-day plan, intended to create the impression of military success and obtain additional support from Western allies, retired Major General Leonid Ivlev, a State Duma lawmaker from Crimea, told TASS.

He noted that Ukraine’s territorial, infrastructural and personnel losses are taking place amid corruption, including the plundering of weapons supplied by Western countries, which then end up on the black market.

На ежегодный конкурс принимаются видеосюжеты или серии материалов из зон боевых действий. Продолжительность — до десяти минут. Участвовать могут как штатные репортёры телеканалов, так и независимые журналисты и блогеры.

description:

If no deal is reached, the US is considering large-scale strikes on Iran.

title: Stocks of key Pentagon munitions have declined to dangerously low levels, with c
description:
Stocks of key Pentagon munitions have declined to dangerously low levels, with commanders seriously concerned, CNN reported, citing sources. 

The US has expended nearly 80% of THAAD interceptors and about half of its Patriot missile stocks due to the war with Iran. 

Senior military advisers warned US President Donald Trump at least twice before his decision to refrain from new strikes last week.
